do.rule: Maintain correct side-gripping of the gourd for all characters handling mate to preserve physical realism.
Maintain clear separation between top caption bars and character head outlines.
When a specific tool or action (like a spoon or scraping motion) is named in the narration, ensure that specific hero object is drawn in the hand and animated.
Keep informational charts and text pills well-aligned above or below key visual elements to maintain clarity.
Ensure background elements remain entirely inside camera viewport bounds.
Maintain consistent character positioning and grounding across sequential shots.
Ensure caption boxes have a safe margin above character heads
Ensure hand models realistically wrap around the mate gourd without body clipping.
Use dedicated motion indicator frames for active object manipulation.
Ensure key object keywords in the voiceover (e.g., 'olla') directly match the primary visual prop drawn in the shot.
Whenever instructional cleaning or preparation steps are spoken (emptying, rinsing, drying), show the specific action or prop rather than a character standing passively.
Ensure captions maintain adequate spacing from the top edge in all vertical frames.
Ensure key visual props and characters mentioned in the voiceover are rendered in the scene.
Ensure handheld props attach directly to ball hands without gaps.
Keep upper screen region clear of overlapping character faces during UI overlays.

avoid.rule: Avoid repeating static character poses across consecutive frames without subtle movement
Avoid static visual repetitions across consecutive short shots to maintain visual interest.
Avoid reusing identical character poses across too many sequential frames without a micro-action.
Avoid reusing particle animation loops across distinct spoken context changes.
Avoid exaggerated object scaling that distorts the physical logic of everyday items.
Do not repeat identical static object shots across consecutive dialogue lines without changing camera perspective or character action.
Avoid overlapping held hero objects directly on body centerlines without offset.
Never place graphic warning marks, text, or crosses over character faces.
Do not mix flat vector templates into pixel8 reels.
Avoid using generic placeholder geometry when specific object flaws are narrated.
Avoid overlapping multiple caption boxes when several family members are grouped together in a single frame.
Never place headline text boxes directly over raised hands or facial expressions.
Do not isolate props onto abstract pedestals when the narrative is about the character carrying them.
Avoid overly plain text lists without contextual illustrations in infographic frames.
Do not repeat identical background asset clusters side by side without varying scale or spacing.
Avoid showing modern mate props (straws/bombillas) during historical origins scenes explaining life before them.
Avoid cropping character foreheads directly beneath multi-line text cards.
Never render handheld props (mate, flasks, cups) without attaching an arm and curling hand explicitly grasping them.
Do not render callout pill badges pointing to a prop when the main headline already states the exact same phrase.
Avoid duplicating large focal props like parrillas or hearths within the same backdrop.
